value.text: Professional services for the design and delivery of a new Regional Animal Facility in Mitchell Park enhancing the quality of life and care delivered to thousands of animals from around the greater Ballarat region that pass through the shelter each year, with a plan to house over 50 dogs and over 130 cats, as well as small animals and livestock.
